svg.title: One event revised; unselected samples preserved
svg.desc: Full one-second layer gain at 25 percent before and 50 percent after, with 160-sample fades inside the selected 800 to 2400 sample span. A separate left-channel zoom shows the actual original and exported mix at the start of the edit. Every sample outside the selected span is retained in both channels. Synthetic supplied layer, not separator output.

g.text: One event revised. Every other sample kept.
Same event ID; replacement, not stacking.
Synthetic supplied layer = 0.6 × original. Linear sample amplitude, not loudness. Both channels checked; no separator inference.
